args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were not dead, but rather trapped in a continuous loop that lasts slightly less than one hour [2]. This loop begins when someone crosses the threshold and ends when the hour turns, at which point anyone inside who cannot "feel" the loop forgets the entire turn and lives it fresh [2]. Because the hour resets before these parties could exit, they have been trapped "walking in" for nine years [2].

The mechanism of the loop is described as follows:
*   **Cause:** The loop was caused when the Lumen Concern dug for lumen and struck "the Whole," causing space to fold and time to catch [5]. This resulted in a state where the building collapsed during the first turn of the loop and has continued to collapse every turn since [5].
*   **Memory and Resetting:** When the hour turns, the room resets individuals to the threshold; for example, Vasht was reset to the threshold, forgetting he had ever reached the candle [3]. Those who cannot "hold the deep Facets back" are reset to the top of the stairs and cannot remember previous attempts [7].
*   **Ode Marran's Memory:** Unlike the others, Odeline Marran can remember every turn because she is one of the few who can resist the reset [7]. Having lived the same hour for nine years, she has watched the shaft fold and unfold "a thousand times," allowing her to know the timing of the loop to the breath [6, 7].
